purpose: Define bounded renewal and fencing so stale holders cannot continue mutating protected resources after lease loss.

topics.name: Lease Renewal and Fencing
topics.purpose: Define bounded renewal and fencing so stale holders cannot continue mutating protected resources after lease loss.

semantics.renew_rule: Renewal targets exact active lease identity/epoch.
semantics.fence_rule: Protected mutation may require current fencing token/epoch.
semantics.stale_rule: Stale holder/token is rejected even if process remains alive.
semantics.expiry_rule: Renewal after expiry follows explicit reacquire semantics rather than silent resurrection.
semantics.authorization_rule: Fencing complements, never replaces, normal authorization.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: expired lease silently renewed as same epoch
